proposed_facts.reason: The traversal computes the maximum inclusive stage requirement, submits it and resets afterward. NULL submits zero; GX's source assertion requires 1–16 and its encoding subtracts one.

The wrapper calls before resetting, GX takes u8 and asserts its permitted range, and render-mode finalization inserts GX_PASSCLR when the stage accumulator is empty. This correctly distinguishes API validity from an unconditional wrapper call.

GXSetNumTexGens consumes the pending count directly. The cited shadow sequence uses null texture inputs but resets only TEV state before committing texgens; those descriptor fields do not establish the independent accumulator's value.
Registration retains a maximum, commit resets after the call, explicit invalidation clears without GX programming, and the NULL texture setup branch returns without clearing pending texgens.
Invalidation performs only software writes. Ambient/material updates retain their source and enable gates, while lighting controls remain comparison-gated.
The stated copy, invalid flags and -1 count value match the implementation. The numeric comparison template is not an independent force-update flag for every possible control request.
All four template entries and both entries of each invalid array are reset. Applicable color paths clear flags before combined-channel GX calls; the channel-count setter contains no cache writeback.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral for all twenty section-subject facts and fourteen section links listed above. Source confirms named allocator, channel-cache, counter, register and scaling behavior, but does not establish compiled section membership, ordering, extent, padding or pooling. Separate baseline edges remain separate. The handoff explicitly corrects the malformed revision in link:319b4b80-0ceb-486e-b9fe-33572080d214's citation; the canonical reset evidence was independently read.

The allocator-related deferral also correctly distinguishes registry duplicate removal from preservation of live pools: initialization clears the descriptor before registering it again. Supported allocator purpose and address flow are retained without a section attribution.

The two superseded TEV-count claims are resolved by proposal indices 0–1: zero forwarding is not valid zero-stage installation. Source assertions and count-minus-one encoding support the correction without asserting a particular compiled assertion configuration.

The two superseded texgen-lifetime claims are resolved by proposal indices 2–3. TEV initialization and textureless descriptors do not reset the texgen accumulator; NULL texture setup does not establish a fresh interval. The actual incoming shadow count remains dependent on preceding state.

The three superseded color-invalidation claims are resolved by proposal indices 4–6. Restoring concrete numeric controls does not independently force all requests, colors remain gated, and channel-count setup never repopulates prev_num_chans. Related section-state deferrals correctly preserve these qualifications.
